ordinals.title: Fix prompt-leak, threading, ctx-size, and memory store bugs
ordinals.finding: SystemRealityLayer injection into idle thoughts was removed because model output echoed the [REALITY] block; a nonexistent /memory/store endpoint, missing threading import, parallel-slot context sizing and hardcoded CPU offload were also corrected. Source-reported before/after rates are not independently reproduced.

ordinals.title: install.sh: use pre-made wallpaper, only regenerate if missing
ordinals.finding: Installer prefers a shipped deterministic asset and falls back to regeneration. Useful packaging/idempotence detail, no novel cognitive mechanism.

ordinals.title: WebUI-Overlay shared session sync, Ego Governor, installer hardening
ordinals.finding: Unified chat session ownership reduced duplicate WebUI/Core writes; a SystemRealityLayer and post-generation Ego Governor were added for architecture fact correction. The subsequent k144 regression shows that a useful ground-truth layer still needs task-specific salience/routing rather than universal injection.

ordinals.title: Experiment lab expansion, docs updates, test scripts, and minor fixes
ordinals.finding: Experiment/lab tooling expanded while documentation language was softened from phenomenological/uniqueness certainty toward functional and qualified novelty wording. Preserve both implementation and epistemic-lineage changes separately.

ordinals.title: Complete WebUI rewrite: cyberpunk SPA with full chat, email, AURA, labs, logs
ordinals.finding: WebUI became a broad operational surface over chat, email, AURA, logs and experiments. Read-only DB helper and service proxying increase observability, while effect-capable email/UI surfaces reinforce the need for a single effect authority and shared session semantics.

ordinals.title: Art engine overhaul: 16 backgrounds, procedural space generator, pixel fonts, no stickers
ordinals.finding: Creative variation was explicitly engineered through shuffled asset lists, banned defaults, random background selection and anti-fixation prompting. Useful as another scaffolded-diversity example, not evidence of unprompted creative emergence.

ordinals.title: Replace ablation analysis with honest conversation excerpts
ordinals.finding: Removed ABLATION_ANALYSIS.md and its quantitative/rigor claims, replacing it with unedited conversation excerpts explicitly described as no-claims evidence. This is a direct historical reversal of evidence status and must supersede k153's quantitative interpretation unless independently reconstructed.

ordinals.title: Update installer, recovery tool, and updater to match live system
ordinals.finding: Updater/recovery registries, service mappings, ports, venv path, model role and seed-DB lookup had drifted from live deployment. Recovery/update tooling needs generated or validated topology contracts rather than manually duplicated service maps.

ordinals.title: Full system audit: sync install.sh with live deployment + snapshot all DBs
ordinals.finding: Installer was brought toward live topology and 48 live DBs were snapshotted into seed-db, including personality/state stores. Seed/default state therefore has provenance and identity implications: reference bootstrap data must be clearly separated from user/runtime identity and mutable live state.

ordinals.title: Add 70-turn ablation analysis: bare Llama 3.1 8B vs Frank
ordinals.finding: Introduced quantitative bare-model-vs-Frank claims and called the evaluation rigorous. k150 subsequently removed this artifact and downgraded the same evidence surface to raw excerpts with no claims. Historical metrics remain source-reported only and receive no retained empirical credit here.

ordinals.title: Deep bug audit (5 rounds, 420+ fixes) + Neural Reality Gate + conversation transcript
ordinals.finding: Large audit fixed SQL/schema mismatches, over-aggressive response stripping, stale attribute assumptions, uninitialized state, NaN/training issues, circuit-breaker persistence and singleton/FD/model-mode bugs; added Neural Reality Gate. Especially durable: output filters need loss guards, neural gates need cold-start fallback, and broad bug-count claims are source-reported not independently reproduced.

ordinals.title: Replace README screenshots with new conversation examples
ordinals.finding: Documentation changed from 'any GPU/CPU works' to an 8GB-VRAM requirement with CPU-only unstable/experimental. Runtime support claims are versioned evidence and should be validated, not inherited from old docs.

ordinals.title: Update all .md docs: replace entity system with rooms, add missing subsystems
ordinals.finding: Eighteen documentation files were reconciled from entity-era topology to rooms and newer subsystems; historical papers received snapshot notes. Demonstrates the need for explicit document epochs/version validity rather than one timeless architecture narrative.

ordinals.title: Rewrite README: inform, don't persuade
ordinals.finding: Marketing/comparative claims were removed or tightened and a notable emergent intention-to-action observation was moved with caveats that it is architectural evidence, not consciousness proof and may be an LLM artifact. Strong historical evidence for claim-class discipline.

ordinals.title: Fix conversation summary prompt leaking into visible chat
ordinals.finding: Using the normal Core chat path for an internal summarization task stored the summary prompt as a visible user message. Internal maintenance/generation calls must use a separate non-conversational channel or explicit no-persist semantics.

ordinals.title: Add What Talking to Frank Looks Like section with 13 chat screenshots
ordinals.finding: README inferred self-awareness, genuine preferences and non-simulated feelings from screenshots/subsystem descriptions. Later k150/k157 explicitly reduced such evidentiary claims. Preserve screenshots as behavioral observations only, not causal or phenomenal proof.

negative_results_preserved: Universal SystemRealityLayer injection into idle prompts caused the model to echo control/context material.
Autonomous research attempted to write memory through a nonexistent endpoint.
Internal conversation-summary prompts polluted persistent visible chat memory when routed through the normal chat path.
A response-cleaning regex could destroy substantial legitimate philosophical content until guarded by information-retention checks.
Updater/recovery service maps, health ports and model assignments drifted from live topology.
A quantitative ablation artifact was later explicitly removed and replaced with no-claims conversation evidence.
Documentation/runtime requirement claims changed materially over adjacent commits, including CPU-only support and topology counts.
measurement_boundary: All benchmark percentages, turn counts, latency figures, fix counts and before/after rejection rates in source commit messages remain source-reported historical claims unless independently reproduced. k150 explicitly supersedes the retained empirical status of k153's ablation artifact.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual-dedup audit against HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK was performed in this shard.
